hooks.command: echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"SessionStart\",\"additionalContext\":\"Before doing anything else, run the startup skill (invoke Skill with skill=startup) to orient on recent commits, working tree state, and relevant memory. common=$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null); gitdir=$(git rev-parse --git-dir 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$common" ] && [ "$common" = "$gitdir" ]; then branch=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Editing directly in the main checkout (branch: %s), not a dedicated worktree. CLAUDE.md workflow: create a GitHub issue, branch, and git worktree before implementation. Proceed anyway, or stop and create a worktree first?"}}' "$branch"; fi
